context.projectOverview: Sprint 5: implement the CodeReviewGraphBackend RESPONSE ADAPTERS for the 5 non-query operations (search, reviewContext, overview, impact, changes), validated against the REAL fixtures captured in Sprint 4 (tests/graph/fixtures/cr-graph/*.json). Each adapter's *Plan method returns {tool, params, narrow} exactly like TokensaveBackend, so GraphClient's sandbox/staleness/health/fallback logic is reused unchanged. The 4 query sub-patterns (callers/callees/imports/tests) are Sprint 6 — leave queryPlan throwing NOT_IMPL this sprint.

crGraphFixtureShape.note: cr-graph output differs from tokensave Ts*Row. Confirmed real shapes (see fixtures + _args.json): nodes carry capitalized Kind ('Function'|'Class'|'File'), line_start/line_end (NOT a single `line`), qualified_name, parent_name, is_test; edges carry confidence/confidence_tier; every payload has a `_graph` staleness envelope + `_hints.next_steps`. The MCP tool names are all `_tool`-suffixed: semantic_search_nodes_tool, get_impact_radius_tool, get_review_context_tool, get_architecture_overview_tool, detect_changes_tool (query_graph_tool + traverse_graph_tool are Sprint 6).
crGraphFixtureShape.mappingTargets: GraphClient consumes: search->SearchHit[]{node:NodeRef,score,snippet}; reviewContext->string; overview->string; impact->ImpactReport{root,affected,testsAffected}; changes->NodeRef[]. NodeRef={id,kind:('function'|'class'|'module'|'symbol'),file,line,symbol}. Map cr-graph Kind->lowercase kind (coerce unknown->'symbol' like tokensave NODE_KINDS); line_start->line; name/qualified_name->symbol. Reuse a toNodeRef-style helper; keep engine scoring semantics faithful (do NOT normalize to tokensave).
